newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Bosnia June output up 10.9 pct m/m, 40.5 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: Bosnia June output up 10.9 pct m/m, 40.5 pct y/y.

text.p: The Statistics Bureau of Bosnia's Moslem-Croat federation issued the following economic indicator details on Tuesday.
BOSNIA INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTION JUNE MAY JUNE 96

NOTES -- The data cover 51 percent of the territory of Bosnia-Hercegovina. No data are available for remaining 49 percent. Bosnian industrial output is up 44.8 percent in Jan-June period compared to the same period in 1996, but June 1997 production is down 86.6 percent compared to the prewar June 1991 output, the office said. -- Sarajevo newsroom, +387-71-663-864.
